surprises.head: Ottawa won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Philadelphia, 3.3 to 2.3, with empty nets left out. L. Ullmark stopped 2.3 more goals than expected.

surprises.head: Philadelphia shot far more than usual
surprises.body: 66.6 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 46.0.

surprises.head: Philadelphia tried a different line
surprises.body: C. Dvorak, O. Tippett, T. Zegras played 8:21 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Philadelphia’s usual lines.
